image_description: A low-resolution, pixelated image of a comic book cover. The cover features vibrant, chaotic artwork with multiple characters in dynamic poses, typical of superhero or action genres. There is a title at the top in stylized lettering and some text boxes/logos at the bottom. The image quality is significantly degraded by compression artifacts and blur.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Severe loss of high-frequency detail across the entire image. Text is completely illegible. Edges of characters bleed into the background. This looks like extreme downsampling or compression artifacting rather than natural optical blur.

Due to the low resolution, facial features and limb details are smeared. It is difficult to distinguish if this is AI 'melting' or just severe pixelation, but the lack of coherent structure in the hands/faces is notable.

The text is entirely nonsensical shapes. While this could be due to resolution, AI generators often fail to render coherent text, resulting in 'fake' letters that look like text from a distance but are gibberish up close. Given the other artifacts, this is likely a generation failure or severe degradation.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a comic book and not just a generic poster or illustration, despite the low quality.
To analyze the illegible text regions. If it detects structured character-like shapes vs random noise, it helps determine if the text was generated poorly or just blurred.
To quantify the severity of the blur and compression artifacts and determine if the underlying structure is coherent despite the noise.
To check if the characters are distinct entities or if they merge into each other/background (fusion artifacts), which is common in low-quality AI generations.

focus_areas: Text legibility and structure (is it real text or AI gibberish?)
Character anatomical coherence (are limbs/faces distinct or melted?)
Boundary separation between foreground characters and background
